# Dependencies

## External Services
- **MySQL** (primary data store)
  - Shared by both CTF server and Auth server
  - Requires TEST_DSN env var for integration tests

## Go Dependencies
```
github.com/go-chi/chi/v5          v5.2.5   (HTTP router)
github.com/go-chi/httprate        v0.15.0  (rate limiting)
github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql    v1.9.3   (MySQL driver)
github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5      v5.3.1   (JWT tokens)
golang.org/x/crypto               v0.50.0  (password hashing, bcrypt)
gopkg.in/yaml.v3                  v3.0.1   (YAML config parsing)
log/slog                          (stdlib) (structured logging)
```

## Internal Dependencies
```
CTF Server → Auth Server (HTTP: /api/v1/verify)
Plugins → pluginutil (shared queries)
Leaderboard → TopThreeProvider (interface dependency)
TopThree → EventBus (subscribes to EventCorrectSubmission)
Cache Plugin → EventBus (subscribes to EventCorrectSubmission for invalidation)
```

## Configuration
- YAML config via `config.yaml`
- Server port, DB connection, auth URL, JWT settings, log settings, rate limit settings, cache settings
- Env vars: TEST_DSN (integration tests)

## Build & Test
```
go build ./...              (build all)
go test ./...               (all tests)
go test ./internal/integration/... -v -count=1  (integration tests, needs MySQL)
```
